text: The Toronto Music Advisory Committee considered presentations on November 8, 2019 on Paris: Do It Yourself Spaces, and the Community Space Tenancy Policy related to City-owned Spaces for Do-it-Yourself Events.

The Economic and Community Development Committee: 1. Requested the General Manager, Economic Development and Culture to consult with stakeholders in the music and arts and culture sector, as part of the work on potential Do-It-Yourself (DIY) venues on city-owned space.
